summary: Architectural view of the two-backend dispatch system, protocol contract, settings pipeline, and known divergences between the Ibis and Iceberg paths.

concepts.name: Backend protocol
recommended_docs: Backend runtime-checkable protocol as the structural contract
All backends must satisfy: connect(), close(), list_tables(), inspect_table(), inspect_catalog()

concepts.name: Ibis backend dispatch path
recommended_docs: IbisBackend construction → dialect resolution → DialectSpec.connection_builder → IbisConnection
Three resolution paths: settings SettingsParameters, URL scheme-to-dialect lookup, direct dialect=kwarg
MotherDuck URL special-case: duckdb://md: → motherduck dialect
evidence: _build_scheme_to_dialect() builds URL→dialect reverse map from DIALECTS at import time

concepts.name: Settings → driver kwargs pipeline
recommended_docs: ConnectionProfile.to_driver_kwargs() → adapter callable or default descriptor driver_key mapping
Adapter pattern: __adapter__ callable(profile) -> dict overrides default kwarg mapping

concepts.name: Iceberg backend dispatch path
recommended_docs: IcebergBackend._CATALOG_REGISTRY maps catalog string → IcebergConnectionBase subclass
IcebergConnectionBase inherits from legacy BaseDBConnection — still uses SettingsParameters
connect_default() hardcodes RestCatalog — non-REST subclasses must override connect_default()

concepts.name: Protocol divergences
recommended_docs: IcebergBackend.inspect_* methods are typed as t.Any, not TableInfo — protocol conformance gap
IcebergConnectionBase has richer surface than the Backend protocol: DataFrame accessors, upsert, schema cache
to_relation() deliberately unimplemented in Iceberg path — waiting on mountainash-expressions
evidence: connection.py 'to_relation() is intentionally NOT implemented' comment

concepts.name: Inspection model (shared contract)
recommended_docs: Four frozen dataclasses are the universal output of all inspect_* calls
Both Ibis and Iceberg inspection convert to this model via their respective inspect.py helpers

documentation_plan: Architecture diagram: Ibis dispatch path (settings → BackendSpec.ibis_dialect → DialectSpec → ibis.connect)
Architecture diagram: Iceberg dispatch path (catalog string → _CATALOG_REGISTRY → IcebergConnectionBase)
Conformance table: which protocol methods each backend implements natively vs delegates
Known divergences: IcebergBackend type annotations, BaseDBConnection legacy, core.registry placeholder
open_questions: When will core.registry be wired up as a unified factory for both backends?
Should IcebergBackend inspection methods be typed as the concrete model types?
